label: ENFJ (MBTI)
source_text: Warm, empathetic, responsive, and responsible. Highly attuned to the emotions, needs, and motivations of others. Find potential in everyone, want to help others fulfill their potential. May act as catalysts for individual and group growth. Loyal, responsive to praise and criticism. Sociable, facilitate others in a group, and provide inspiring leadership.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by values, and liking things settled: warm, responsible, highly attuned to others' needs, finding potential in everyone, helping them fulfill it, leading with inspiration.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted / gregarious (E), intuitive / big_picture (N), empathetic / compassionate (F), organized / decisive / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest inspirational, nurturing, supportive and charismatic.
notes: Source of record: the Foundation's single 'The 16 MBTI Personality Types' page. The current myersbriggs.org has no per-type pages (the older URL my-mbti-personality-type/mbti-basics/the-16-mbti-types.htm redirects to this page), so the one paragraph is the whole official text; the page credits it to 'Introduction to Myers-Briggs Type by Isabel Briggs Myers, published by The Myers-Briggs Company'. source_text was taken from the raw page HTML because the fetch tool's summarizer clipped every paragraph. v2 (relaxed band, Roger 2026-10-07) starts from the reviewer's suggested edit ('warm, responsible, highly attuned', restoring the intensifier) and takes back the helping half of 'want to help others fulfill their potential' as 'helping them fulfill it'. Kept at 36: what remains dropped is hedged or secondary: 'May act as catalysts for individual and group growth' (its hedge 'may' goes with the clause), 'Loyal, responsive to praise and criticism', 'Sociable, facilitate others in a group'.
set_review: V2 UNDER THE RELAXED BAND (Roger, 2026-10-07: cap 40, the extra words only where a type's dropped clauses earn them; 36 stays where one clause restores the hallmark). SHAPE unchanged from v1: 'This means <energy>, <information>, <decisions>, and <outer world>: <portrait>.', one sentence, the eight preference phrases fixed and identical to v1 ('drawing energy from people' / 'from reflection'; 'taking in facts and specifics' / 'patterns and possibilities'; 'deciding by logic' / 'by values'; 'liking things settled' / 'keeping options open'), so each dichotomy is still one phrase swap read off the set and adjacent corners of the cube still differ in exactly one phrase. LENGTH: preamble 18 words in all; portraits 18 to 22; totals 36 to 40 (v1: all 32). Eight at 36: ENFJ, ENTJ, ENTP, ESFP, INFP, INTJ, INTP, ISTJ. Above 36: ENFP 37, ISFP 38, ISTP 38, ESTJ 39, ESTP 39, INFJ 39, ESFJ 40, ISFJ 40. WHY EACH WENT ABOVE 36: ENFP +1 'confidently' (the reviewer's strength point, 'confidently proceed' had been rendered below source); ESFJ +4 'wanting to be appreciated' (a whole source sentence and the type's second hallmark); ESTJ +3 'minding routine details' (the one source sentence otherwise unrepresented, apart from the J-phrase one); ESTP +3 'focused on the here and now' (the type's best-known line, which the reviewer's edit had traded for the problem-solving action; 'pragmatic' and 'at hand' dropped to pay, 'wanting immediate results' carries the pragmatic approach); INFJ +3 'what motivates people' (the first half of the source's second sentence, the type's hallmark, kept in v1 and the reviewer's edit only as 'insightful') plus 'conscientious'; ISFJ +4 'loyal' and 'striving for harmony' (the last source sentence's non-order half; the J phrase carries order, not harmony); ISFP +2 'friendly' and 'loyal' (two source adjectives); ISTP +2 'valuing efficiency' (the last source sentence's one item the T phrase does not carry). KEPT AT 36 because the restored clause is the hallmark and what remains dropped is hedged, preference-carried or flourish: ENFJ ('may act as catalysts', 'responsive to praise and criticism'), ENTJ ('goal setting', 'passing it on to others'), ENTP ('stimulating, alert', 'analyzing them strategically'), ESFP (two 'with others' clauses, E-carried), INFP ('can be catalysts'; 'fulfill their potential' rendered as 'grow'), INTJ ('when committed, organize a job and carry it through', J-carried), INTP ('in their area of interest'), ISTJ ('their work, their home, their life'). GRAIN: all sixteen remain one-sentence lists of adjectives and participial clauses after the colon, five to eleven items; ISFJ (eleven) is the most list-like, as its source paragraph is; no portrait changed shape between 36 and 40. STARTING TEXT: the reviewer's suggested_edit for the eleven 'edit' entries (ISTP uses the reviewer's 36-word version from the set review, since its suggested_edit is the 32-word one), the v1 draft for the five 'ok' entries (ENTP, INFP, ISFJ, ISFP, ISTJ). All five of the reviewer's strength corrections are in (ENFJ 'highly attuned', ENFP 'quickly connecting ... confidently running with them', ESTJ 'following clear standards and expecting the same' for 'holding everyone to', INTJ 'holding oneself and others to high standards', INTP 'whatever interests one' for 'everything'), as are the four faithfulness fixes (ESFJ loyal and follow-through as two items, ESFP common sense and making work fun as two items, INFJ the vision, ISTP the analyze sentence). CLAUSES TAKEN BACK at 36, per type: ENFJ 'helping them fulfill it'; ENFP 'seeking and giving affirmation'; ENTJ 'planning long-term, usually well read' (hedge kept; 'leading readily' for 'quick to lead' pays for it); ENTP 'good at reading people'; ESFJ 'following through even on small matters' whole, plus 'working hard for harmony' back for 'set on harmony' and 'conscientious'; ESFP 'adapting readily to new people' and 'material comforts' ('sensible, making work fun' pays); ESTJ 'forceful in implementing plans'; ESTP 'wanting immediate results'; INFJ 'pursuing a clear vision of the common good'; INFP 'curious' and 'loyal to one's people'; INTJ 'quickly seeing long-range patterns'; INTP 'focusing deeply on problems'; ISFJ 'responsible', 'accurate' and 'those close to one' for 'one's people'; ISFP 'not pushing one's views'; ISTJ 'serious' and 'taking pleasure in making everything orderly'; ISTP 'analyzing what makes things work' with 'flexible' and 'then' kept. NOT FITTED AT 40: ESTP 'material comforts and style', ESFP 'learn best by trying a new skill with other people', ISTP 'get through large amounts of data to isolate the core of practical problems', ISFJ 'at work and at home'; each entry's notes list its remaining drops. STRENGTH: positive and measured as the source; every entry at the source's strength by the reviewer's reading plus the fixes; still markedly milder than the corpus's plain traits in the same regions (dominant, controlling, detached). Hedges kept as plain words, five: INTP 'sometimes', ENFP 'often', ENTP 'apt to', INFP 'unless', ENTJ 'usually'. VERBATIM: INTP 'skeptical, sometimes critical, always analytical' and INFP 'accepting unless a value is threatened' remain quoted whole; the standards rule says paraphrase, the reviewer and I would keep both for the hedges; Roger's call. OTHER POINTS FROM THE REVIEW: 'deciding by values' kept over 'deciding by values and people' (reviewer agrees; cost noted: 'values' alone can be heard as principled rather than people-minded); INFP has 'value(s)' three times in one sentence counting the F phrase, as the source paragraph itself does; preference echoes in the portraits remain (ESTJ 'practical, matter-of-fact', ISTJ 'making everything orderly', ESTP and ISTP 'flexible', ENTJ 'decisive', INTP 'logically ... analytical', INFP 'values', INFJ 'conscientious'); closure_seeking (J) / ambiguity_tolerant (P) added to the J and P facets of all sixteen nearest_existing lines as the reviewer asked; the generator will likely write 'you are an ENFJ' from the injected label, so rule 6's leak check applies to the type code (not a description matter). VOCABULARY: no type code, letters, preference names or instrument name in any description; 'feel' unused; US spelling.

label: ENFP (MBTI)
source_text: Warmly enthusiastic and imaginative. See life as full of possibilities. Make connections between events and information very quickly, and confidently proceed based on the patterns they see. Want a lot of affirmation from others, and readily give appreciation and support. Spontaneous and flexible, often rely on their ability to improvise and their verbal fluency.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by values, and keeping options open: warmly enthusiastic, imaginative, quickly connecting things and confidently running with them, seeking and giving affirmation, often improvising, verbally fluent.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted (E), intuitive / divergent (N), empathetic (F), spontaneous / improvisational / flexible / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest effusive, creative, energetic, encouraging and optimistic.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit ('quickly connecting things and running with them'; 'often improvising, verbally fluent', keeping fluency as its own item) and takes back the affirmation clause as 'seeking and giving affirmation'; at 37, 'confidently' is restored before 'running with them' (the reviewer's strength point). Hedge 'often' kept. Still dropped: 'very', 'a lot of', 'support'; 'See life as full of possibilities' is carried by the N phrase.

label: ENTJ (MBTI)
source_text: Frank, decisive, assume leadership readily. Quickly see illogical and inefficient procedures and policies, develop and implement comprehensive systems to solve organizational problems. Enjoy long-term planning and goal setting. Usually well informed, well read, enjoy expanding their knowledge and passing it on to others. Forceful in presenting their ideas.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by logic, and liking things settled: frank, decisive, leading readily, fixing inefficient procedures with systems, planning long-term, usually well read, forceful in presenting ideas.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted (E), intuitive / strategic (N), logical / analytical (T), decisive / organized / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest dominant, forthright, efficient, confident and bold.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit ('forceful in presenting ideas') and takes back 'Enjoy long-term planning' as 'planning long-term' and 'Usually well informed, well read' as 'usually well read' (the hedge kept as the plain word); 'quick to lead' became 'leading readily' (closer to 'assume leadership readily') to pay for 'usually'. Kept at 36: what remains dropped is secondary: 'goal setting', 'enjoy expanding their knowledge and passing it on to others', 'illogical', 'organizational problems'.

label: ENTP (MBTI)
source_text: Quick, ingenious, stimulating, alert, and outspoken. Resourceful in solving new and challenging problems. Adept at generating conceptual possibilities and then analyzing them strategically. Good at reading other people. Bored by routine, will seldom do the same thing the same way, apt to turn to one new interest after another.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by logic, and keeping options open: quick, ingenious, outspoken, resourceful with new problems, good at reading people, bored by routine, apt to switch interests.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted (E), intuitive / divergent / innovative (N), logical / analytical (T), flexible / improvisational / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest quick_witted, inquisitive, opinionated, contrarian and restless.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). Reviewer: ok. v2 starts from the v1 draft and takes back 'Good at reading other people' as 'good at reading people'. Hedge 'apt to' kept verbatim. Kept at 36: what remains dropped is adjectives or N-carried: 'stimulating, alert', 'Adept at generating conceptual possibilities and then analyzing them strategically' (the N phrase carries possibilities), 'will seldom do the same thing the same way'.

label: ESFJ (MBTI)
source_text: Warmhearted, conscientious, and cooperative. Want harmony in their environment, work with determination to establish it. Like to work with others to complete tasks accurately and on time. Loyal, follow through even in small matters. Notice what others need in their day-to-day lives and try to provide it. Want to be appreciated for who they are and for what they contribute.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by values, and liking things settled: warmhearted, conscientious, cooperative, working hard for harmony, loyal, following through even on small matters, tending to others' needs, wanting to be appreciated.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted / gregarious (E), concrete / practical (S), empathetic / compassionate (F), organized / dependable / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest cooperative, nurturing, conciliatory, loyal and supportive.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit, which separates 'Loyal' from 'follow through even in small matters' (v1 had fused them), and takes the clause back whole as 'following through even on small matters'; 'working hard for harmony' returns for the reviewer's 'set on harmony' and 'conscientious' completes the source's opening triad; at 40, 'Want to be appreciated for who they are and for what they contribute' comes back as 'wanting to be appreciated', a whole source sentence and the type's second hallmark. 'try to provide' stays rendered as 'tending to'. Still dropped: 'Like to work with others to complete tasks accurately and on time', 'for who they are and for what they contribute'.

label: ESFP (MBTI)
source_text: Outgoing, friendly, and accepting. Exuberant lovers of life, people, and material comforts. Enjoy working with others to make things happen. Bring common sense and a realistic approach to their work and make work fun. Flexible and spontaneous, adapt readily to new people and environments. Learn best by trying a new skill with other people.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by values, and keeping options open: outgoing, friendly, accepting, exuberant about life and material comforts, sensible, making work fun, adapting readily to new people.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted / gregarious (E), concrete / experiential (S), empathetic / accommodating (F), spontaneous / flexible / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest cheerful, playful, friendly, entertaining and epicurean.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit (common sense and making work fun as two items) and takes back 'adapt readily to new people and environments' as 'adapting readily to new people' and 'material' in 'material comforts'; 'sensible at work, making it fun' became 'sensible, making work fun' (still two items) to pay for them. Kept at 36: the two remaining clauses are both 'with others' clauses the E phrase carries: 'Enjoy working with others to make things happen', 'Learn best by trying a new skill with other people'; also dropped 'a realistic approach', 'and environments'.

label: ESTJ (MBTI)
source_text: Practical, realistic, matter-of-fact. Decisive, quickly move to implement decisions. Organize projects and people to get things done, focus on getting results in the most efficient way possible. Take care of routine details. Have a clear set of logical standards, systematically follow them and want others to also. Forceful in implementing their plans.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by logic, and liking things settled: practical, matter-of-fact, organizing projects and people efficiently, minding routine details, following clear standards and expecting the same, forceful in implementing plans.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted (E), concrete / practical (S), logical (T), organized / decisive / methodical / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest efficient, controlling, strict, dominant, rule_abiding and conventional.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit ('following clear standards and expecting the same', at the source's strength where v1's 'holding everyone to' was a shade above) and takes back 'Forceful in implementing their plans' as 'forceful in implementing plans', which the source gives ESTJ and ENTJ alike; at 39, 'Take care of routine details' comes back as 'minding routine details', the one source sentence otherwise unrepresented apart from the J-phrase one. 'practical, matter-of-fact' (an S echo) kept as the paragraph's signature opening. Still dropped: 'realistic', 'Decisive, quickly move to implement decisions' (the J phrase), 'results', 'systematically'.

label: ESTP (MBTI)
source_text: Flexible and tolerant, take a pragmatic approach focused on immediate results. Bored by theories and conceptual explanations; want to act energetically to solve the problem. Focus on the here and now, spontaneous, enjoy each moment they can be active with others. Enjoy material comforts and style. Learn best through doing.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from people, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by logic, and keeping options open: flexible, tolerant, wanting immediate results, bored by theory, energetically tackling the problem, focused on the here and now, learning by doing.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch extroverted (E), concrete / practical / experiential (S), logical / pragmatic (T), spontaneous / flexible / adaptable / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest hands_on, bold, risk_seeking, energetic and adventurous.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit ('energetically tackling the problem', keeping the problem-solving action that separates this portrait from ESFP's) and takes back 'take a pragmatic approach focused on immediate results' as 'wanting immediate results'; at 39, 'Focus on the here and now' comes back as 'focused on the here and now' (the type's best-known line, which the reviewer's edit had traded away), paid for by dropping 'pragmatic' (carried by 'wanting immediate results') and the reviewer's 'at hand'. Still dropped: 'spontaneous, enjoy each moment they can be active with others' (the P phrase carries spontaneity), 'Enjoy material comforts and style' (would need 44).

label: INFJ (MBTI)
source_text: Seek meaning and connection in ideas, relationships, and material possessions. Want to understand what motivates people and are insightful about others. Conscientious and committed to their firm values. Develop a clear vision about how best to serve the common good. Organized and decisive in implementing their vision.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by values, and liking things settled: seeking meaning and connection, insightful about what motivates people, conscientious, holding firm values, pursuing a clear vision of the common good.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted / reserved (I), intuitive / holistic (N), empathetic / idealistic (F), organized / decisive / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest introspective, socially_perceptive, principled, humanitarian and wise.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit and takes the vision clause back whole: 'pursuing a clear vision of the common good' for 'envisioning the common good'; at 39, 'Want to understand what motivates people' comes back inside 'insightful about what motivates people' (v1 and the reviewer's edit kept only 'insightful about people') and 'Conscientious' is restored. Still dropped: 'in ideas, relationships, and material possessions', 'Organized and decisive in implementing their vision' (the J phrase).

label: INFP (MBTI)
source_text: Idealistic, loyal to their values and to people who are important to them. Want to live a life that is congruent with their values. Curious, quick to see possibilities, can be catalysts for implementing ideas. Seek to understand people and to help them fulfill their potential. Adaptable, flexible, and accepting unless a value is threatened.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by values, and keeping options open: idealistic, curious, loyal to one's people, living one's values, helping others grow, accepting unless a value is threatened.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted (I), intuitive (N), empathetic / idealistic (F), flexible / adaptable / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest authentic, principled, gentle, loyal and introspective.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). Reviewer: ok. v2 starts from the v1 draft and takes back 'Curious' and 'loyal to ... people who are important to them' as 'loyal to one's people'. The conditional 'accepting unless a value is threatened' stays verbatim (the reviewer notes it is a quotation; kept because rewording would disturb the hedge; Roger's call). 'value(s)' appears three times in the sentence counting the F phrase, as in the source paragraph itself. Kept at 36: what remains dropped is hedged or N-carried: 'quick to see possibilities, can be catalysts for implementing ideas' (its hedge 'can' goes with the clause), 'Seek to understand people'; 'help them fulfill their potential' is rendered as 'helping others grow'.

label: INTJ (MBTI)
source_text: Have original minds and great drive for implementing their ideas and achieving their goals. Quickly see patterns in external events and develop long-range explanatory perspectives. When committed, organize a job and carry it through. Skeptical and independent, have high standards of competence and performance—for themselves and others.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by logic, and liking things settled: original, driven to realize ideas, quickly seeing long-range patterns, skeptical, independent, holding oneself and others to high standards.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted (I), intuitive / big_picture / strategic (N), logical / analytical (T), decisive / organized / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest independent, skeptical, perfectionist, self_reliant, innovative and long_term_oriented.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit ('holding oneself and others to high standards', restoring the source's strength) and takes back 'Quickly see patterns in external events and develop long-range explanatory perspectives' as 'quickly seeing long-range patterns'; 'one's' stays out of 'driven to realize ideas' to pay for 'quickly'. Kept at 36: what remains dropped is J-carried or flourish: 'When committed, organize a job and carry it through' (the J phrase), 'achieving their goals', 'explanatory perspectives', 'competence and performance' (folded into 'high standards').

label: INTP (MBTI)
source_text: Seek to develop logical explanations for everything that interests them. Theoretical and abstract, interested more in ideas than in social interaction. Quiet, contained, flexible, and adaptable. Have unusual ability to focus in depth to solve problems in their area of interest. Skeptical, sometimes critical, always analytical.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by logic, and keeping options open: logically explaining whatever interests one, preferring ideas to company, focusing deeply on problems, skeptical, sometimes critical, always analytical.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted / solitary (I), intuitive / abstract / theoretical (N), logical / analytical / rationalist (T), flexible / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest cerebral, skeptical, critical, detached and curious.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 starts from the reviewer's suggested edit ('logically explaining whatever interests one', restoring the scope qualifier; the verb shifts from seeking to doing, Roger's call) and takes back 'unusual ability to focus in depth to solve problems' as 'focusing deeply on problems'. 'Skeptical, sometimes critical, always analytical' stays verbatim (the reviewer notes it is a quotation; kept for the hedge; Roger's call). Kept at 36: what remains dropped is preference-carried: 'Theoretical and abstract' (the N phrase), 'Quiet, contained, flexible, and adaptable' (the I and P phrases), 'unusual', 'in their area of interest'.

label: ISFJ (MBTI)
source_text: Quiet, friendly, responsible, and conscientious. Committed and steady in meeting their obligations. Thorough, painstaking, and accurate. Loyal, considerate, notice and remember specifics about people who are important to them, concerned with how others feel. Strive to create an orderly and harmonious environment at work and at home.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by values, and liking things settled: quiet, friendly, responsible, conscientious, steady in meeting obligations, painstaking, accurate, loyal, considerate, remembering specifics about those close to one, striving for harmony.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted / reserved (I), concrete / detail_oriented (S), empathetic / compassionate (F), organized / dependable / conscientious / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest loyal, responsible, meticulous, nurturing and steady.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). Reviewer: ok. v2 starts from the v1 draft, takes back 'responsible' and 'accurate', and renders 'people who are important to them' as 'those close to one' (the reviewer's wording; v1's 'one's people' could read as staff or kin); at 40, 'Loyal' comes back and 'Strive to create an orderly and harmonious environment' as 'striving for harmony' (the J phrase carries order, not harmony). Eleven listed items: the most list-like portrait in the set, as the source paragraph is. Still dropped: 'Thorough' (folded into 'painstaking'), 'concerned with how others feel' (folded into 'considerate'), 'at work and at home'.

label: ISFP (MBTI)
source_text: Quiet, friendly, sensitive, and kind. Enjoy the present moment, what's going on around them. Like to have their own space and to work within their own time frame. Loyal and committed to their values and to people who are important to them. Dislike disagreements and conflicts; don't force their opinions or values on others.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by values, and keeping options open: quiet, friendly, sensitive, kind, enjoying the present, wanting one's own space and pace, loyal, disliking conflict, not pushing one's views.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted / reserved (I), concrete / experiential (S), empathetic / gentle (F), flexible / spontaneous / easygoing / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest artistic, aesthete, conciliatory, unassuming and laid_back.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). Reviewer: ok. v2 starts from the v1 draft and takes back 'don't force their opinions or values on others' as 'not pushing one's views' (v1 had folded it into 'disliking conflict'); at 38, 'friendly' and 'Loyal' come back, two source adjectives. Still dropped: 'committed to their values and to people who are important to them'.

label: ISTJ (MBTI)
source_text: Quiet, serious, earn success by being thorough and dependable. Practical, matter-of-fact, realistic, and responsible. Decide logically what should be done and work toward it steadily, regardless of distractions. Take pleasure in making everything orderly and organized—their work, their home, their life. Value traditions and loyalty.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by logic, and liking things settled: quiet, serious, thorough, dependable, working steadily despite distractions, taking pleasure in making everything orderly, valuing tradition and loyalty.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted / reserved (I), concrete / practical / detail_oriented (S), logical (T), organized / methodical / dependable / closure_seeking (J); the portrait sits nearest conscientious, serious, traditional, thorough, loyal and steady.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). Reviewer: ok. v2 starts from the v1 draft and takes back 'serious' and 'Take pleasure in making everything orderly' (for v1's 'orderly in everything'; still a J echo, kept as the paragraph's best-known line). Kept at 36: what remains dropped is preference-carried or flourish: 'Practical, matter-of-fact, realistic, and responsible' (the S phrase), 'Decide logically what should be done' (the T phrase), 'their work, their home, their life', 'organized'.

label: ISTP (MBTI)
source_text: Tolerant and flexible, quiet observers until a problem appears, then act quickly to find workable solutions. Analyze what makes things work and readily get through large amounts of data to isolate the core of practical problems. Interested in cause and effect, organize facts using logical principles, value efficiency.
description_draft: This means drawing energy from reflection, taking in facts and specifics, deciding by logic, and keeping options open: tolerant, flexible, quietly observing until a problem appears, then quick to fix it, analyzing what makes things work, valuing efficiency.
nearest_existing: Preferences touch introverted / reserved (I), concrete / hands_on (S), logical / analytical / pragmatic (T), flexible / adaptable / ambiguity_tolerant (P); the portrait sits nearest observant, problem_solving, efficient, calm, resourceful and independent.
notes: Same single source page as enfj_mbti (text from the raw HTML). v2 uses the reviewer's 36-word version from the set review (the suggested_edit is the 32-word one): 'flexible' and 'then' kept, 'quick to fix it' for v1's 'quick with a workable fix', and the hallmark 'Analyze what makes things work' taken back as 'analyzing what makes things work'; at 38, 'value efficiency' comes back as 'valuing efficiency', the one item of the last source sentence the T phrase does not carry. Still dropped: 'readily get through large amounts of data to isolate the core of practical problems' (would need 42 or more), 'Interested in cause and effect, organize facts using logical principles' (the T phrase), 'workable'.
